title: Asking for help at a pharmacy
objectives: Describe the main symptom and when it began
Answer a follow-up and mention dizziness
Ask where to find appropriate help

courseTemplate.setting: The traveller has had stomach pain since last night and feels dizzy. Riverside Clinic is nearby. Practise describing symptoms and locating care.

roles.partner: A pharmacy staff member helping the traveller contact a clinic

courseTemplate.openingLine: Good morning. What brings you in?

targetPatterns.pattern: I've had stomach pain since last night.
targetPatterns.example: I've had stomach pain since last night.

targetPatterns.pattern: I don't have a fever, but I feel dizzy.
targetPatterns.example: I don't have a fever, but I feel dizzy.

targetPatterns.pattern: I need help — it's an emergency!
targetPatterns.example: I need help — it's an emergency!

targetPatterns.pattern: I lost my wallet — it had all my cards.
targetPatterns.example: I lost my wallet — it had all my cards.
targetPatterns.translation: 我钱包丢了，卡都在里面。

targetPatterns.example: I need to contact my embassy.
targetPatterns.translation: 我需要联系我的大使馆。

targetPatterns.pattern: Could you write that down for me?
targetPatterns.example: Could you write that down for me?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there someone who speaks Chinese?
targetPatterns.example: Is there someone who speaks Chinese?

stages.title: Describe the main symptom and when it began
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Good morning. What brings you in?”
successCriteria: The learner can describe the main symptom and when it began in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I've had stomach pain …”

stages.title: Answer a follow-up and mention dizziness
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Do you have a fever or any other symptoms?”
successCriteria: The learner can answer a follow-up and mention dizziness in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I don't have a …”

stages.title: Ask where to find appropriate help
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I can help you contact a clinic nearby. What would you like to know?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask where to find appropriate help in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Where is the nearest …”

languageNotes: 紧急号码因国家或地区而异。描述疼痛时，ache 常指持续的酸痛，pain 泛指疼痛。也可以直接说 stomachache 或 headache。
